title: Clamp
description:
Return `n` clamped to the range `[lo, hi]`. If `n < lo`, return `lo`. If `n > hi`, return `hi`. Otherwise return `n`.

**Example:**
```
clamp(5, 1, 10) → 5
clamp(-3, 0, 100) → 0
clamp(150, 0, 100) → 100
```
hint: Use two if statements: one to clamp below lo, one to clamp above hi.
